data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Narial was the name of a water nymph or the goddess of night dew. In the New Testament, this name is given to one of the seventy-two disciples of Jesus Christ. It symbolizes refreshment and renewal. The name Narial carries the meaning “Night dew” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Narial usually hope their child will grow to embody night dew and live with faith, good character and purpose.
